hypotheses.J0_forms_are_approximately_jointly_diago: The rotation removes at least 70% of normalized off-diagonal form energy.
hypotheses.J1_diagonal_program_is_sufficient: The optimized diagonal-only program lies within 0.10 causal fidelity of the full natural rank-32 program on every corpus.
hypotheses.J2_rotation_improves_diagonal_program: Optimized diagonal fidelity exceeds PCA-coordinate diagonal fidelity by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J3_diagonal_program_beats_random_rotatio: Optimized diagonal fidelity exceeds a matched random-rotation diagonal by at least 0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J4_canonical_axes_are_multistart_stable: Three additional starts have objective CV at most 0.05 and mean best-axis absolute overlap at least 0.90 with the identity start.
hypotheses.J5_cross_terms_are_causally_necessary: On at least one corpus, the full natural rank-32 program exceeds diagonal-only fidelity by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.J6_sixtyfour_cross_pairs_are_sufficient: The diagonal plus 64 discovery-ranked off-diagonal pairs lies within 0.05 fidelity of the full natural rank-32 program on every corpus.
hypotheses.J7_discovery_pair_ranking_beats_weight_o: At 32 or 64 pairs, discovery-ranked fidelity exceeds weight-energy-ranked fidelity by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
